mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_session (tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, client_ip, user_agent, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, client_ip, user_agent, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_login_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_login_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_login_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
